Cedric: Hello, {VAR 0100 0000}!
How is {VAR 0101 0001}?{VAR BE01}

Ah! This {VAR 0101 0001} has really taken
a shine to you.{VAR BE01}

The Pokédex is important, but time spent
having fun together is also important.{VAR BE01}
Say, I just had a thought--
have you heard of Dragonspiral Tower?

Really?
Quite impressive.{VAR BE01}

Eh... I'm not surprised you haven't
heard of it.{VAR BE01}
Brycen: Who are you?{VAR BE01}

Bianca: Who? Us?{VAR BE01}
I'm Bianca, and this is Cheren...{VAR BE01}

Brycen: I know you are there!
Why don't you show yourselves?{VAR BE01}

Always, the tower looms,
disdainful of the wind and snow.{VAR BE01}
Perhaps its presence has
a special meaning for people.

The Gym Leader Brycen
is the strong and silent type.{VAR BE01}
I can understand why some people
call him a fighting machine.

Dance, dance!
Two dragons!

Spin! ♪ Spin! ♪
Turn and spin! ♪

Spin apart!
Mix and twirl!

Mix it up, day and night!
'Cause today, everything's all right! ♪

If you walk in the wetlands, you might
surprise wild Pokémon into popping out!

When the wetlands freeze, it's slippery.
I wonder how wetland Pokémon manage?
